assay: bulk mRNA-seq (TruSeq stranded, NovaSeq 52-bp PE), quadriceps muscle, male C57BL/6NTac mice on western diet
sample_inclusion: 2^3 full factorial, 8 groups x 8 mice = 64; 2 mice removed (stroke at surgery; button infection) -> 62 (S4.3.2.p1, S4.4.1.p1)
primary_estimand: Main effect of 4 weeks of voluntary wheel running (VWR vs sedentary) on quadriceps gene expression, averaged over the NR and PT arms; wheels locked before the last dark phase, so a chronic training effect, not acute exercise
planned_contrasts: VWR main effect (S2.6.p3; paper: 2,245 protein-coding genes at q < 0.05)
NR main effect (S2.6.p1; paper: 4 protein-coding genes: Nmrk2 down, Art3, Myh8, Mymk up)
NR x PT x VWR interactions (S2.6.p1; paper: none at q < 0.05)
paper_method: edgeR v3.30.3 quasi-likelihood NB GLM, ~ group + RIN, group = 4 (or 8) combinations of NR, VWR (and PT); effects from contrasts between group levels; FDR q-values (S4.4.10.p3)

paper_results.VWR: 2,245 protein-coding genes q < 0.05; Art3 down (q=0.019), Mymk down (q=0.006); Cd38, Sirt3, Sirt5 up; NAD+ synthesis genes (Nmrk1, Nmrk2, Nmnat1, Nmnat3, Nadsyn1, Naprt, Qprt, Nampt) unchanged
paper_results.NR: Nmrk2 down about 65%, Art3 up, Myh8 up, Mymk up
paper_results.GO: camera GO, top-10 terms up with VWR (Fig 6J)
